body.x: Zipper Inc. (CEO Seunghyun Lim) will attend CES 2025 from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas and present its personalized card design application and kiosk solution at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Founded in 2023, Zipper is a Korean startup offering a design platform emphasizing analog charm and creativity. Its namesake application, Zipper, lets users easily personalize cards with features such as photo editing, text input, stickers, and various card-sized templates. The platform’s intuitive interface simplifies the design process, making creative expression accessible to everyone.
At CES 2025, Zipper will showcase its app and highlight its ability to personalize physical cards, aiming to expand into new global markets.

The Zipper platform offers features like personalized card design, object extraction, customizable cutouts, and optimized template suggestions. According to the company, 92% of users can complete professional-quality designs within 10 minutes, making Zipper more convenient.

Zipper has developed a dedicated kiosk system to extend its offline digital platform. This kiosk lets users retrieve and instantly print their designs as visually striking plastic cards. With a "golden ratio" of 1:1:1.61804, the cards provide aesthetic appeal for various applications, including commemorative cards and customized gifts.
Through this service, Zipper aims to collaborate with manufacturers of domestic and international check cards, transportation cards, and gift cards.

A Zipper representative stated, “The rising trend of ‘young-tro’ and ‘new-tro’ among younger generations highlights a growing demand for self-expression. Our O2O2O (Offline to Online to Offline) approach enables users to capture memories offline, design them online, and then re-materialize them as physical cards.”

The company plans to use CES 2025 to introduce its unique platform to the U.S. market, where demand for analog aesthetics is expected to be significant. Zipper also envisions collaborations with public institutions seeking innovative ways to commemorate locations or with companies aiming to launch distinctive promotional campaigns.
